account: Elice announced on 6 February 2025 that its information textbooks with AI Helpy had passed state screening. AI digital textbooks entered Korean schools in March 2025. Elice describes an AI textbook platform with tailored feedback, language support and teacher oversight, including a pilot. Elice reports no measured learning gain and no measured saving of teacher time. In interviews with seven secondary teachers in the first semester of 2025, Lee and Kim found that use of AI digital textbooks was low and that teachers reported added workload. Independent studies report that adoption in the first semester of 2025 stood in the 30 percent range. In August 2025 the National Assembly passed a law that made AI digital textbooks educational materials and removed their textbook status.
